d:
My first original longform comic.
Girl Me! is the story of Addison Holt, who finds herself in the company of two down-on-their-luck Succubi, Valeria and Abyssal. The two are stuck on Earth with their powers heavily stripped, forced to pay penance for some undisclosed punishment. Having to meet an ever changing quota in order to return their full power, and be welcomed back home.

Addison comes across Valeria in a chance meeting, and instead of simply draining her and moving on, Valeria sees opportunity. If by chance her quota could be hastened by a third, then she could continue to live her life on her own infernal terms. She offers Addison the chance to become a succubus, with all the powers and benefits it entails – at the cost of her humanity that is. Addison, who’s still a trans girl in the closet, leaps at the chance with a very enthusiastic “Girl me!” Even with Valeria’s hesitations and “are you sure?” Addison’s eagerness overtook the cautions.

Thus begins Addison’s Journey as a young succubus, learning how to use her powers and abilities and struggling with her new hungers and urges. Unsurprisingly, Val’s plan doesn’t go how she wanted, and is now forced to restart her punishment, with Addie only adding to the end quota. Much to Abyss’ frustrations. Now the three must learn to coexist and cooperate as their powers grow together. How will Addison adapt to her new body, and new life
n: [Western] [LariUmbreon] Girl Me! How I Got Turned Into a Girl by a Desperate Succubus! (In Progress)
